title: Use of Ganoderma lucidum grown on agricultural waste to remove antibiotics from water
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1499-1508
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06482A, Paper

Vanessa Juarez, Shiva Emami, Ameer Y. Taha, Valeria La Saponara
Antibiotic-rich effluents from farming and medical establishments into waterways pose a serious risk for antibiotics resistance, promoting a need for effective strategies of removal from the food chain and the environment.
